notes.title: Update
notes.content: The entire Heroes Rise Series has been updated to include more gender options, including both transgender and nonbinary options. So, whether you're beginning your story anew in [i]Heroes Rise: The Prodigy[/i], you're joining America's #1 super powered reality TV show in [i]Heroes Rise: The Hero Project[/i], or you're fighting the powers that be in [i]Heroes Rise: HeroFall[/i], you'll now be able to do it as yourself.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Heroes Rise: HeroFall, 26% off!
notes.content:
Heroes Rise: HeroFall is Now Available on Steam and is 26% off!*

Would a hero like you assassinate the president? "Heroes Rise: HeroFall" concludes the epic "Heroes Rise" trilogy of interactive novels where your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based—without graphics or sound effects—and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

Also, check out the Heroes Rise Trilogy Bundle, including all three games and all their DLC, launching at 13% off!

*Offer ends July 18 at 10AM Pacific Time
